title: Protocol definition
description: protocol_versions.definition: what the extraction worker reads to run a study protocol. Written by the researcher portal (protocol editor) and validated against this schema before a version is published; published versions are immutable and identified by definition_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON of this document (object keys sorted recursively by UTF-16 code units as in RFC 8785, arrays in order, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8). Event type labels and the generated JSON Schema for observations.attributes live in the event_types table; this document holds what the model needs. Keys not listed here (e.g. sampling settings added later) are allowed and preserved when a version is copied.

event_types.description: Keys of the event types this version detects, one event_types row each. Keys are stable across versions: longitudinal analyses group by key.

observation_prompt.description: Free-text instructions for the multimodal extraction model: what to look for in the selected clips and how to fill the variables. It must not ask for things listed in out_of_scope.

variables.description: Structured variables extracted for each observation. Each one becomes a property of observations.attributes for the event types listed in applies_to.

out_of_scope.description: What this protocol explicitly does not measure (e.g. calories, portion_weight, nutrients for the eating vertical). Shown to researchers; the extraction model must not report it.

sensors.description: Sensor sampling per sensor_types key, e.g. {"temperature_c": {"period_s": 60}}. Not edited by the portal; kept when a version is copied.

camera.description: Camera capture settings, e.g. {"fps": 2, "resolution": "VGA"}. Not edited by the portal; kept when a version is copied.

pipeline.description: Optional overrides of the process_session pipeline settings (snake_case positive numbers, e.g. {"merge_gap_s": 30}); see resolveConfig in worker/src/process-session/protocol.ts. Not edited by the portal; kept when a version is copied.

type.description: enum: one of allowed_values. boolean, number, text: a single value. string_list: a list of strings, restricted to allowed_values when present.

description.description: What the variable means, for the extraction model and for researchers.

required.description: Whether every observation of an applicable event type must report this variable.

applies_to.description: Event type keys (from event_types) whose observations carry this variable.
